mechanism_narrative: The steady four-week improvement in RETAIL_REC from -38.7 to -31.9 reflects a persistent reopening momentum that will continue, lifting the next 28-day mean above the last 28-day mean.
failure_condition: The mean of RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: A weekly mean of WORKPLACES below -27% signals a new work-from-home wave that removes commuter foot traffic, causing RETAIL_REC to decline over the following two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks even though WORKPLACES is below -27%.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility improves above -25% while TRANSIT remains below -40%, consumers are engaging in local outdoor activity and avoiding public transit, which boosts nearby retail footfall.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks when PARKS > -25% and TRANSIT < -40%.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime marked by RESIDENTIAL above 13% and WORKPLACES below -25%, retail mobility will fall over the next week as stay-at-home orders reduce shopping trips.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next week while RESIDENTIAL > 13% and WORKPLACES < -25%.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week drop in GROCERY_PHARM of more than 1.5 points signals the end of a grocery stock-up phase, freeing up household budgets and time for discretionary retail, raising RETAIL_REC.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls by more than 1.5 points week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC declines over the next two weeks following a week-on-week drop in GROCERY_PHARM greater than 1.5 points.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous week-on-week increase in RESIDENTIAL and decrease in WORKPLACES indicates a voluntary or mandated retreat indoors, which reduces retail-and-recreation mobility in the subsequent two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL increases week-on-week and WORKPLACES decreases week-on-week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next two weeks despite RESIDENTIAL rising and WORKPLACES falling week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery of TRANSIT above -40% reflects loosened travel restrictions and restored consumer confidence, which will lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next four weeks when TRANSIT exceeds -40%.

mechanism_narrative: The gap between PARKS (improving to -21.7) and RETAIL_REC (improving to -31.9) indicates unmet demand for outdoor activity that will spill over into retail as capacity limits ease, lifting RETAIL_REC over four weeks.
failure_condition: The gap between PARKS and RETAIL_REC does not narrow over the next four weeks, or RETAIL_REC falls.
